analysis.hypothesis: the exact-gradient action wins more often than the shortcut action across comparable cases
analysis.primary_estimand: exact-gradient wins divided by comparable action pairs
secondary_estimands: exact-gradient wins divided by all attempted cases
comparable action pairs divided by all attempted cases

sampling.seed_selection: fixed contiguous seeds 0 through 15 at every Rayleigh number
sampling.stopping_rule: run and report all 48 planned attempts; do not stop based on outcomes

failure_policy.base_not_converged: retain as a solver failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator
failure_policy.inconclusive: retain as an action-comparison failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator
failure_policy.runner_failure: retain as an orchestration failure; exclude from the comparable-case denominator and include in the all-attempt denominator
failure_policy.nonzero_exit_with_valid_report: use the report; intervention_robustness.py uses a nonzero exit when no comparison is available
failure_policy.resume: never rerun an attempt with a valid durable attempt record
